intended_object: A derivation transformer showing the converse direction of the deduction theorem: from a proof of Γ ⊢ A → B it builds a proof of Γ ∪ {A} ⊢ B. It is ported from Flypitch, which the docstring names.
explanation: `prf` is an inductive family valued in `Type`, so derivations are data. That is why this result is stated as a `def` and not a `theorem`. The body weakens the hypothesis to `insert A Γ`, then applies implication elimination (modus ponens) with the axiom `A ∈ insert A Γ`. This is correct, but it is a proof of a metatheoretic lemma (one direction of the deduction theorem) packaged as a function on proof terms. It is not a definition of a mathematical object, so it is an auxiliary proof construction.
